definitions.explanation: Carp-shaped windsocks traditionally flown during Children's Day (May 5th) to wish for the health and success of children, especially boys.

examples.japanese: ⟦{五月|ごがつ}→五月：00625_gogatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{鯉|こい}のぼり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧。
examples.english: Carp streamers swim in the sky when May comes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{鯉|こい}のぼり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てた→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: We put up large carp streamers in the garden.

examples.japanese: {鯉|こい}のぼり⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{願|ねが}う→願う：02387_negau⟧。
examples.english: Carp streamers express wishes for children's growth.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
{鯉|こい}のぼり are flown for こどもの⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (Children's Day, May 5th), part of ⟦{端午|たんご}→端午：28695_tango⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{節句|せっく}→節句：26925_sekku⟧ (Boys' Festival).

SYMBOLISM:
The carp symbolizes strength and perseverance because it swims upstream. According to legend, a carp that successfully climbs a waterfall becomes a dragon.

TYPICAL SET:
- ⟦{真鯉|まごい}→真鯉：noentry⟧: black carp (father)
- ⟦{緋鯉|ひごい}→緋鯉：noentry⟧: red carp (mother)
- ⟦{子鯉|こごい}→子鯉：noentry⟧: smaller carp (children)
- ⟦{吹流|ふきなが}し→吹流し：noentry⟧: streamer at the top

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鯉|こい}のぼり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揚|あ}げる→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧: to fly carp streamers
- {鯉|こい}のぼり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧: carp streamers "swim" (flutter in wind)
